{'translation': '一個新的開源工具近日引起熱議，聲稱可以讓對 Apple Intelligence 不感興趣的用戶在 Mac 上面重新取回 12GB 或以上的儲存空間。詳情如下。', 'source': 'A new open-source tool has been making the rounds this week, claiming to give users who aren’t interested in Apple Intelligence their 12GB or more of storage back on their Mac. Here are the details.'}

{'translation': '「在 macOS 27 上停用 Apple Intelligence 並移除已下載的模型」', 'source': '"Disable Apple Intelligence and remove downloaded models on macOS 27"'}

{'translation': '和許多公司在旗下平台加入各式 AI 工具和模型一樣，Apple 因為部分用戶覺得多餘、還會佔用儲存空間的功能而受到批評。', 'source': 'Like many companies adding various AI tools and models to their platforms, Apple has been criticized for features that some users find unnecessary and that also take up storage space.'}

{'translation': 'Apple Intelligence 在 macOS 26 原本需要最多 7GB 儲存空間，但到了 macOS 27，這個數字已經大幅增加，Apple 現在表示他們的最新模型在新型號 Mac 上面可能需要多達 14GB 空間。', 'source': 'Apple Intelligence originally required up to 7GB of storage in macOS 26, but that number has grown significantly in macOS 27, where Apple now says its latest models could require up to 14GB on newer Mac models.'}

{'translation': '有見及此，獨立開發者 Om Lahore 上週末在 GitHub 上面發佈了一個名為 RemoveMacAI 的項目，聲稱可以「在 macOS 27 上停用 Apple Intelligence 並移除已下載的模型」。', 'source': 'In response, independent developer Om Lahore released a project called RemoveMacAI on GitHub at the end of last week, claiming to "disable Apple Intelligence and remove downloaded models on macOS 27."'}

{'translation': 'Lahara 解釋指，他的工具可以啟用一個設定描述檔，套用 Apple 本身的限制鍵（restriction keys）去關閉 Apple Intelligence 功能，同時利用 Apple 的資產服務（asset services）移除已下載的模型，並防止 macOS 再次下載它們。', 'source': 'Lahara explains that his tool can enable a configuration profile that applies Apple’s own restriction keys to turn off Apple Intelligence features, while also using Apple’s asset services to remove the downloaded models and prevent macOS from downloading them again.'}

{'translation': '他還詳細列出工具會移除哪些項目、哪些功能會被停用，以及用戶運行之後可以預期的情況：', 'source': 'He also has a detailed list of what the tool removes, what is disabled, and what users can expect after running it:'}

{'translation': '停用的功能：Siri（包括「喂 Siri」和選單列圖示）、書寫工具（Writing Tools）、Genmoji、Image Playground、ChatGPT 延伸功能、郵件、訊息、Safari、備忘錄和通知的摘要功能、郵件智慧回覆、行內文字預測、空間相片（Spatial Photos）、相片清除工具（Photos Clean Up），以及 Xcode 預測式代碼補全。移除的模型：Apple Intelligence 基礎模型，以及圖像生成和 Genmoji、空間相片、相片清除工具、Xcode 代碼補全的模型。', 'source': 'Features disabled: Siri (including “Hey Siri” and menu bar icon), Writing Tools, Genmoji, Image Playground, ChatGPT extension, summarization for Mail, Messages, Safari, Notes, and notifications, Mail smart replies, inline text predictions, Spatial Photos, Photos Clean Up, and Xcode predictive code completion. Models removed: Apple Intelligence base model, plus image generation and Genmoji, Spatial Photos, Photos Clean Up, and Xcode code completion models.'}

{'translation': '和', 'source': 'and'}

{'translation': 'Lahara 指出，運行 RemoveMacAI 之後聽寫功能仍然可以正常運作，因為「聽寫是一個獨立的設定，它的語言模型並沒有被移除」。', 'source': 'Lahara notes that Dictation still works after running RemoveMacAI because “Dictation is a separate setting, its language model is not removed.”'}

{'translation': '最後，他補充指整個過程是可以還原的，完整詳情和教學可以在這裡看到。', 'source': 'Finally, he adds that the entire process is reversible, and full details and instructions are available here.'}

{'translation': '9to5Mac 的看法', 'source': '9to5Mac’s take'}

{'translation': '雖然部分人對 Apple Intelligence 佔用 Mac 儲存空間的強烈反彈，似乎與對任何 AI 相關事物的本能抗拒沒太大分別，但對於內部儲存空間有限的用戶——尤其是用緊 256GB Mac 的人——取回 12GB 或以上的空間確實是一個合理的憂慮。', 'source': 'While some of the strong pushback against Apple Intelligence taking up Mac storage may not be that different from a knee-jerk reaction against anything AI-related, for users with limited internal storage—especially those with a 256GB Mac—getting 12GB or more back is a legitimate concern.'}

{'translation': '還有一個更根本的問題是對自己作業系統的基本控制權：對 Apple Intelligence 沒興趣的用戶應該可以很輕鬆地完全關閉它，並取回被其模型佔用的儲存空間，就像他們可以管理系統裡其他應用程式或可選元件一樣。', 'source': 'There is also a more fundamental question about basic control over your own operating system: users who aren’t interested in Apple Intelligence should be able to easily turn it off completely and reclaim the storage that its models take up, just as they can manage other apps or optional components on their system.'}

{'translation': '不過，Apple 會否嘗試將此項目從 GitHub 上下架，又或者改變 macOS 的底層機制，令 Apple Intelligence 的模型更難被移除，仍然有待觀察。', 'source': 'Whether Apple will try to get the project taken down from GitHub, or change the underlying mechanisms in macOS to make it harder to remove the Apple Intelligence models, remains to be seen, however.'}

{'translation': '同樣地，停用或移除這些元件會對 macOS 本身——甚至對越來越依賴 Apple 模型去提供基本功能的第三方應用程式——產生什麼影響，都是無從得知。', 'source': 'It’s also impossible to know what impact disabling or removing these components could have on macOS itself—or even on third-party apps that increasingly rely on Apple’s models to provide basic functionality.'}

{'translation': '雖然 RemoveMacAI 是開源的，而且不需要關閉系統完整性保護（SIP），但它仍然依賴設定描述檔、限制鍵和系統服務，而這些東西 Apple 隨時可以更改。', 'source': 'While RemoveMacAI is open source and doesn’t require disabling System Integrity Protection (SIP), it still relies on configuration profiles, restriction keys, and system services that Apple can change at any time.'}

{'translation': '換句話說，未來的 macOS 更新有可能會令此工具的部分功能失效，甚至可能導致用戶遇到意料之外的情況，直至項目更新為止。', 'source': 'In other words, future macOS updates could break some of the tool’s functionality, or even cause users to experience unexpected things until the project is updated.'}

{'translation': '目前，任何考慮使用 RemoveMacAI 的人都應該明白，這是一個非官方的第三方工具，會對系統作出改動，並且應該對其運作方式感到安心。', 'source': 'For now, anyone considering using RemoveMacAI should understand that this is an unofficial third-party tool that makes changes to your system, and should be comfortable with how it works.'}

{'translation': '講清楚，RemoveMacAI 似乎是一個用心良苦的開源項目，目的是給 Mac 用戶對運行在其電腦上的東西和儲存空間的使用方式有更大的自主權和控制權。只是無法知道 Apple 會否有同樣的看法。', 'source': 'Make no mistake, RemoveMacAI seems like a well-intentioned open-source project that aims to give Mac users more agency and control over what runs on their computer and how their storage is used. There’s just no way to know if Apple will see it the same way.'}
